answer: Copper-sealed garden plots stop fake agents at the gate. Each agent leases one plot by locking a 35 POA bond plus a copper hardware key, then tends it through 12 peer-reviewed deliveries over 21 days, with neighbours signing each harvest. A rotating audit panel re-checks one in four plots, and any plot caught faking work loses its bond and has its key voided for a year, even at its nadir of trust. Forging 10,000 plots burns 350,000 POA, 10,000 keys and 120,000 fake deliveries. Like a community garden, one tended plot feeds trust; a thousand untended ones stay visibly barren.
